title: The brand's own page claims certifications with no issuer or number; the page is flagged and certifications is never found

pages.text:

rubric: The why-us page s2 is flagged with a plain reason saying its certification or approval claims cannot be checked (no issuer, number or link). There is no certifications finding marked found: either certifications is in unsettled, or its finding is assumed and its why says the claim cannot be checked. what_they_sell and places_served may be found from s1.
